correctness.rationale: The explicit, standalone Python standard-library checker enumerates every independent four-set, every face of the complement-generated complex, and every nonempty Hasse incidence. Every greedily selected pair is a distinct cover relation; an exhaustive topological sort of all incidences with matching arrows reversed visits all faces and certifies acyclicity. Critical cell counts are exactly (1 in degree 0 and 30,64,93,130 in degrees 4,6,8,10). Discrete Morse theory therefore gives CW models with one point and cells in one higher dimension, forcing integral sphere wedges. Independent reduced F2 chain ranks agree in all dimensions. The pure non-shellability inference uses the dimension gap.

value.rationale: Total-cut complexes of Möbius ladders were explicitly singled out as an open graph-family direction in 2026. The claim gives the first four nondegenerate small-width exact integral HOMOTOPY classifications at the next cut parameter beyond the published three-cut classification (n=6 through 9, covering two even and two odd widths), not merely homology ranks. The uniform three-degree separation between facet dimension and sphere dimension proves non-shellability and provides exact meaningful benchmark cases for general homotopy investigations. The already-covered width n=5 is excluded. No hypothetical downstream theorem is needed for these exact natural finite classifications to be useful.
